properties.description: The root of the `in_memory` test program: it declares as modules every test file of reflow2-mcp whose tests need no store in a folder (153 at the merge with #755), so they compile and link once and their tests are named `<file>::<test>`. Builds without RocksDB; a disk test inside one of its files is marked `#[cfg(feature = "rocksdb")]`. Its tests share one process.
properties.name: tests/in_memory.rs — the MCP crate's in-memory test program
